weaknesses.title: DELETEWHERE is process-local — plate dumps rehydrate freed jobs
weaknesses.detail: GC must RM dump/jN for each name in DELETEWHERE bag or next ARG run restores objects. No cascade free→plate. Same class as DELETEALL trap.
weaknesses.repro: DELETEWHERE state stale without RM dump; next list rehydrates

weaknesses.title: DELETEWHERE/SENDWHERE equality only — no multi-state or range GC
weaknesses.detail: Cannot DELETEWHERE state in {done,failed} or tries>3. Agents run multiple gc_state or EACH.
weaknesses.repro: need two DELETEWHERE for done+failed cleanup

weaknesses.title: SENDWHERE miss method soft skip — no hard fail mode
weaknesses.detail: SENDWHERE Job state queued no_meth_zz → N=0 SKIP>0 OK=1. Typo methods silent under -s without agent checks.
